debrief db-021
1) the ac-tor s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c s-e-n-s-o-r r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e-s with f-a-l-s-e t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e d-a-t-a and l-e-f-t c-l-o-n-e-d f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t s-w-i-p-e l-o-g-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the ac-tor r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d a f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y in the h-r d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e and l-e-f-t a f-a-k-e e-m-p-l-o-y-e e-n-t-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-a-n-a-g-e-r a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l s-t-e-p
3) the ac-tor r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e with a s-p-o-o-f e-u-l-i-a and l-e-f-t s-w-a-p-p-e-d d-r-i-v-e-r f-i-l-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the h-a-s-h c-h-e-c-k p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e
4) the ac-tor t-i-m-b-e-r-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g s-y-s-t-e-m to r-e-f-l-e-c-t the f-a-l-s-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y's e-n-t-r-a-n-c-e and l-e-f-t c-o-v-e-r-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-a-l-t-i-m-e a-l-e-r-t m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g
5) the ac-tor s-t-a-g-e-d the d-e-b-r-i-e-f r-e-p-o-r-t to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e the b-i-o-s-p-o-o-f o-r-i-g-i-n and l-e-f-t d-o-c-t-o-r-e-d t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c c-h-a-i-n-o-f-c-u-s-t-o-d-y c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
